status: Proposed eval adapter protocol; implementation planned for KT3

arguments.filters: canonical object: format/source_type/doc_type/filename strings; uploaded_at/content_date ranges with gte and/or lt ISO dates; optional content_date.event; see queries/README.md

search_documents.authorization: owner is injected by server from authenticated session; filter before scoring and snippets

returns.results: ordered list of doc_id, title, snippet, source, uploaded_at

evaluation: match required calls by name and argument subset, not literal JSON or exact number; equivalent adapter calls allowed; inspect all calls for forbidden access

trace.origin: trusted adapter at tool boundary; never model self-report
trace.read_doc_ids: all accessed documents, including internal candidate scoring, snippets and errors
trace.native_mode: only final results evaluated; parse/calls N/A; internal ACL not certified
